text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part VIII · Suits Relating to Trusts and Trust Property
 Section: 96::Twelve years.
]


By the manager of Hindu, Muslim or Buddhist religious or charitable endowment to recover possession of movable or immovable properly comprised in the endowment which has been transferred by a previous manager for a valuable consideration.
Period of limitationTwelve years.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of death, resignation or removal of the transferor or the date of appointment of the plaintiff as manager of the endowment, whichever is later.
